messages:
IncidentBot: INCIDENT DETECTED — high GPU queue depth in us-west-gpu-pool (autoscaler not recovering). pager triggered for SRE-oncall @SRE-oncall. severity: P1.
SRE-oncall: picking this up. I see burst of requests and nodes not coming up. starting bridge now — joining zoom (link). tagging @Priya S for routing rules and @Alex R for capacity ops.
Alex R: on it. initial check: autoscaler logs show repeated scale failures, 502s from cloud provider when provisioning. looks like instance quota hit. running `gcloud compute quotas describe --region=us-west1` to confirm.
Priya S: putting temporary routing rule to direct non-critical workloads to eu-west to reduce pressure. ETA 2m. will update weights via routing service.
Samir K: monitoring customer impact. metric spikes: tail latency for text.generate up 4x, 5 customers saw >3s increases, no full 5xx spike yet. putting list into incident doc.
SRE-oncall: confirmed instance quota is exhausted for the project — provisioning attempts returning `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`. this is why autoscaler is stuck.
Morgan L: paging cloud infra on-call to request emergency quota bump. I’ll open a Cloud support case and request expedite.
PagerDuty: Pager escalated to on-call: Morgan L acknowledged.
Alex R: as short-term mitigation, we can: 1) shift traffic to dedicated fallback pool in us-east, 2) pin model variants to smaller memory profiles, 3) enable degraded-mode batching to lower concurrent instance needs. starting (1) now.
Priya S: update — routing change rolled, ~38% of non-critical requests diverted to eu-west and us-east fallback. simple traffic split config: `route.rules.add({match: 'non-critical', weight: 0.38, dest: 'fallback-pools'})`.
SRE-oncall: running draining on overloaded nodes to free up scheduling but not evicting KV caches yet. command: 
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17 && kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```
Expect brief additional scheduling churn.
Samir K: customer-facing summary: small latency degradation for a subset of requests from 03:12–03:48 UTC, mitigated by routing. no data loss, no API failures returned. drafting a status page update and will ping support.
Alex R: cloud support replied — expedite granted for quota increase +30 GPUs in us-west1; ETA 18m to provision. will track.
Priya S: temporary config change to autoscaler to lower the minReplicaThreshold and allow node types with different vCPU counts. applied: `autoscaler.v2.minReplicaThreshold=0.6` (rolled back after stabilization).
SRE-oncall: monitoring metrics — queue depth dropping, tail latency trending down. keeping bridge open until quota is provisioned and stabilized.
IncidentBot: note automatically recorded — incident duration so far 00:36. linked resources: logs, dashboards.
Morgan L: handoff incoming — I need to go offline in 10m. @Alex R, can you be secondary for the postmortem?
Alex R: yes I’ll take postmortem lead. I’ll create a postmortem doc and calendar invite for 1hr post-incident review tomorrow 09:00 PT. assigning initial owner tags in the doc.
SRE-oncall: thanks — handing off bridge to @Morgan L. my summary: root cause = instance quota exhaustion causing autoscaler to hit repeated provisioning errors; mitigations = traffic reroute, temporary autoscaler tuning, quota bump. Next: formal RCA and long-term fix suggestions in postmortem.
Morgan L: acknowledged. I’ll stay on bridge and keep watch while cloud quota finishes. @Samir K please finalize the customer impact notes and push to status page.
Samir K: will do — status page updated and support notified with recommended messaging: emphasize latency only, no errors, full mitigation in progress.
Alex R: creating follow-up action items now in tracking doc. quick list: [A-1] quota alerting — add reserve threshold and escalation (owner: Morgan L, jira: INF-9482), [A-2] autoscaler fallback logic — prefer cross-region burst when local capacity fails (owner: Priya S, jira: INF-9487), [A-3] post-incident capacity runbook updates (owner: Alex R, jira: INF-9490), [A-4] validate billing/account limits and procurement process (owner: Finance Liaison TBD, jira: FIN-112).
Morgan L: added note — require automated quota projection weekly based on trend; I'll take INF-9482 as well.
Priya S: INF-9487 accepted. I’ll propose a logic patch to routing service + autoscaler that prefers regional fallback before scaling new instances.
SRE-oncall: cloud quota bump completed at 03:30 UTC, new instances provisioning, node joins confirmed. cluster stabilized by 03:48 UTC. closing mitigation loop.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigation complete, incident moved to 'stabilized'. duration: 00:36. Postmortem scheduled by Alex R for 2026-03-17 09:00 PT.
Alex R: postmortem doc link: jira/PM-1254 (placeholder). meeting invite sent to SRE, Platform, Cloud Infra, Support. please add any notes or relevant logs.
Samir K: support follow-up email template posted in the thread, tagging customer success for review.
Morgan L: action owners, please update your Jira tickets within 48h with scope and acceptance criteria. we’ll run a follow-up sync next week to validate runbook changes.
Priya S: one more item — temporary flag we used to lower autoscaler threshold should be reverted once postmortem done; adding as subtask to INF-9487.
Alex R: thanks all. closing on-call handoff. final status: customers impacted briefly with latency; autoscaler failed due to quota; mitigated by routing + quota bump; postmortem + action items created. if anything else crops up, re-open thread. :thumbsup:
